title: Ultra-high strength WNbMoTaV high-entropy alloys with fine grain structure fabricated by powder metallurgical process
process_description: prepared by high-energy ball milling of elemental W, Nb, Ta, V, and Mo powders (purity >99%, particle size <75 µm) in a planetary ball mill at 300 rpm with 10:1 ball-to-powder ratio under argon atmosphere for 6 hours. Powders were sintered via spark plasma sintering at 50 MPa pressure under vacuum (<10 Pa) with heating to 600°C in 1 minute, followed by 100°C/min heating to 1500-1700°C and 5-minute holding time.
